mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media_upload_sessions (id, account_id, asset_type, filename, content_type, expected_size, expected_sha256, storage_key, idempotency_key, status, expires_at) VALUES (#{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.assets.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.MediaAssetUuidTypeHandler}, #{accountId}, #{assetType}, #{originalFilename}, #{contentType}, #{expectedSize}, #{expectedSha256}, #{storageKey}, #{idempotencyKey}, 'PENDING_UPLOAD', #{expiresAt}) ON CONFLICT (account_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id AS accountId, storage_key AS storageKey FROM media_upload_sessions WHERE status = 'PENDING_UPLOAD' AND expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY expires_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT session.id, session.storage_key AS storageKey FROM media_upload_sessions session WHERE session.status = 'REJECTED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM media_storage_cleanup_tasks cleanup WHERE cleanup.storage_key = session.storage_key ) ORDER BY session.created_at ASC, session.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
